fields.acceptance: A web package test renders /runs over fixture journals with live, done and failed runs and asserts their order, fields and links, and that the list section declares the run events.
fields.statement: The Runs page at /runs lists live runs first, then recent ones newest first, each with its short ID, change set title, workflow, state, current step and start time, linking to its run page; the list re-renders live on run journal moves.

fields.acceptance: A web package test renders /runs/<id> for a fixture plan run and a fixture review run and asserts the steps in order with outcomes, the sessions and the review summary's findings, and a 404 for an unknown run.
fields.statement: A run's page at /runs/<id> shows its steps from the journal as a timeline with each step's outcome and time, the agent sessions of each step with their status, and for a review run its review summary with findings and severities; it re-renders live on that run's journal moves.

fields.acceptance: A web package test renders a fixture run's log tail with its last lines, appends lines and reads them through the run's log event and fragment, and asserts the no-log state for a run without one.
fields.statement: A headless run's page shows the last lines of its driver log in an always-dark terminal block that follows new lines live, and says so when the run has no log.
